'''Durgen's Star''' was a [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarf]] [[Star/Legends|star]] that was located in the [[Durgen's Star system/Legends|Durgen's Star system]]. It was situated in the [[Loop Worlds]] area of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]], within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Durgen's Star lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Junction-Tierell Loop/Legends|Junction-Tierell Loop]], which connected it to the [[Povanaria system/Legends|Povanaria]] and [[Trinovat system/Legends|Trinovat systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

The star was circled by a debris field of tumbling rock and [[Water/Legends|ice]] fragments that was a remnant of an ancient [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]. According to [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] tales, [[Prospector/Legends|prospectors]] at some point discovered unusual, unimaginably ancient technology of unknown purpose in the Durgen's Star debris,<ref name="TEA" /> and by [[43 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The main section of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' ends with a mention of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]]'s journey across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the beginning of which is depicted in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''. The events of that novel are dated to [[43 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> generations of [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations, lured by those rumors, had searched the debris field for anything worth extracting.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Durgen's Star was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it in grid square P-6.<ref name="TEA" />
